b: Dunlop has introduced the Way Huge Smalls Green Rhino Overdrive, resurrecting an iconic pedal from the Way Huge oeuvre.
Designed around vintage overdrive topology, this Green Rhino Overdrive recreates the 1995 version’s classic midrange muscle with all the clarity, punch, and dynamic response of the original.

The new pedalboard-friendly version has been meticulously designed with through-hole construction and premium components to capture the same feel, touch sensitivity, and harmonic richness that made the original a cult favorite. At its heart, an LF353 op-amp generates classic feedback clipping for smooth, musical saturation, while high-gain MPSA18 transistors groan with increased warmth and harmonic detail. It’s all packed into the modern Way Huge Smalls enclosure with true-bypass switching.
Operation is simple, with Volume, Tone, and Drive allowing full and immediate control of its unmistakably warm tone—ideal for boosting, edge-of-breakup drive, or classic rock and blues grit.
Way Huge Smalls Green Rhino Overdrive highlights:
Recreates the original 1995 Green Rhino Overdrive II in the pedalboard-friendly Smalls enclosure
Classic feedback clipping for smooth, musical saturation
Through-hole construction for vintage tone and serviceability
LF353 op-amp for warm, dynamic response
MPSA18 transistors for increased gain and harmonic detail
9-volt operation powered by battery or external DC power supply
True bypass, just like the original
The Way Huge Smalls Green Rhino Overdrive is available at a $139.99 street price. For more information, visit jimdunlop.com/way-huge-smalls-green-rhino-overdrive
